gen-dafont-galaxy-switzer: Galaxy hits with a dense, tall lowercase and loosely spaced letters, every stroke the same width. Switzer follows in a plain sans with wiry, tube-like forms; give it a size a notch above usual text so its tall waist line shows.
gen-gf-grandstander-archivo: Grandstander is chunky and expressive, its lines the same width through curves and straights, with short ascenders over a tall x-height. Archivo takes a more editorial tone beside it, with curves that open outward and a lowercase that still commands attention.
gen-dafont-groovy-fs-merriweather-sans: A narrow slit where the c almost closes gives Groovy its funky, friendly grin, and the lowercase is loosely tracked. Merriweather Sans is the opposite in the best way: its tall lowercase looks sturdy, and the e opens clearly to the right.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-fs-epilogue: Wobbly and playful, Jelly Crazies seals its bowls almost shut. Epilogue loosens everything up with curvy, wire-like monoline letters and a tall lowercase, so give it a modest size and let it breathe.
gen-dafont-nasalization-fs-supreme: Friendly letters, floating apart. Nasalization is best at round, unswelling bowls and a calipers-style c with short ascenders, while Supreme does its best work as a crisp sans with a heavy-looking band of text through the middle.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-general-sans: Neuropolitical looks like neon tubing, words pulled apart letter by letter. General Sans fills the line with a tall x-height and smooth bends, so a text size slightly smaller than you'd guess should hold up well.
gen-dafont-nordic-manrope: Nordic spaces its letters like brush dabs far apart, with cramped, almost folded openings. It brings ancient power, while Manrope does the everyday talking as a plain sans with bright open curves and a minimal step from capitals to lowercase.
gen-dafont-origami-work-sans: Origami looks like single-stroke sign painting, with a lowercase mass like poured lead type. And Work Sans, a plain sans with a high mean line and tidy joins, would keep a long page feeling modern and easy going.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-switzer: Outrun Future spreads its letters wide, with an outline you could trace with a finger, in a synthwave voice. And Switzer, a plain sans with wire-like forms, can sit at a slightly larger size so its tall waist line shows.
gen-gf-gugi-archivo: Tall lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals sets Gugi apart. Archivo sits beside it with outward-opening curves and a commanding x-height, so the bold heading and the editorial sans share the page without crowding each other.
